The '''Octavia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Nicandra sector/Legends|Nicandra sector]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Octavian fruit pudding]].<ref name="Planet Plague">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Planet Plague]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Octavian fruit pudding]]|system=Octavia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Octavia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-7.<ref name="TEA" />
